[[File:DeprivationRitual.png|thumb|right|250px|Yoda undergoes the deprivation ritual in the Jedi Temple.]]
A '''deprivation ritual''' was a procedure which allowed a user to be brought as close to [[Death/Legends|death]] as possible, without actually becoming one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] underwent one such procedure during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
